title: Unit Event — Competitive Fire! — Episode4 Tension in the Air

meta.Event Outline: When Vivid BAD SQUAD go for a meal with Ken, Taiga and the twins before their return to Japan, an unexpected reunion sparks a newfound fire in An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry, Elena!
This is all just a big misunderstanding...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wasn't looking where I was going, and I almost bumped into him. It's really not his fault...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Don't go anywhere near this guy, An.

Some minor business.
The owner and I go a long way back.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (There's so much tension in the air...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (He seems to know Elena and Becky...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Did something happen?
The atmosphere's gotten very tense...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: He started out as a nobody with one microphone, and now he's a big-time producer with his name all over the industry.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: He doesn't appear in the media a lot, but his music's got a pretty serious following.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: But I am happy that young musicians such as yourselves know about me.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: Are you friends of my daughters?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wait, that means he's Elena and Becky's...?)

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
I'm Slade and this is Cedric...
We're in a team called Embers.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: We're friends of Elena and Becky.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: Rumor has it that you're one of the hottest young groups out there. It's an honor to meet you two.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
Likewise.
We didn't think that someone like you would know who we are, DG.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: Good team name. I'll be sure to remember it.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: I'll apologize for losing my temper a bit back there.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: But we don't want anything to do with you now.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line:
I know.
Believe me, I don't want to be babysitting you forever either.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making things so awkward for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Douglas
rows.Line: I hope we meet again someday.

rows.Speaker: Spectator Ａ
rows.Line: “Hey, was that DG who just walked by us?!”

rows.Speaker: Spectator Ｂ
rows.Line: “No way! I'm a huge fan! What's he doing here?!”

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: “Next, Embers! Can we get you guys on standby?”

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Oh, that's us...! We're up next!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't wait to hear you two sing together!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We only got to hear one of you sing in Japan. Better impress us.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: You got it! Let's go, Ceddy!

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Don't go anywhere near this guy, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I wonder what happened between them and their dad?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But it wouldn't be right for an outsider like me to ask.)

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: I'm really sorry about that, An!

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: We sorta made things awkward, huh? Didn't mean to make you worry.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: For now, let's just try to have fun, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We finally get to hear them all sing!)
